{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Read the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Remove the 6 QA rows with revenue = 999999.99
df_clean = df[df['revenue'] != '999999.99']

# Convert revenue to float
df_clean['revenue_float'] = df_clean['revenue'].str.replace(',', '').astype(float)

# Remove refunded orders
df_final = df_clean[df_clean['status'] == 'completed']

# Check channel distribution by customer segment
tab = pd.crosstab(df_final['channel'], df_final['customer_segment'])
print("Cross-tabulation of channel vs customer_segment:")
print(tab)

# Check if the groups are comparable
print("\nChannel proportions by segment:")
print(tab.div(tab.sum(axis=1), axis=0))"}
